_meta.about: Awakening cut-in illustrations (docs/specs/feel.md 6.6, WP7). Separate from tools/kling/manifest.json so the shared manifest never conflicts. Entries with `file` are the ones used; `*_aN` entries are rejected attempts with the reason.
_meta.tool: image_to_image (image_1 = the hero portrait uploaded via the Kling file upload tool, referenced as 图片1)
_meta.budget: 12 images per spec; 9 used (Sera 3 attempts, Bran 2)
_meta.processing: tools/kling/cutin_process.py: retouch (pseudo-text print/engraving only) -> 1600:637 crop window chosen from raw_face with the bottom >= 8% always removed (watermark) -> 1600x637 WebP q82 m6 -> checks -> tools/kling/cutin_anchors.json
_meta.raw_face/raw_eye: face centre / glint eye, 0..1 in the raw 3104x1312 Kling output (measured on a 0.02 grid)

cutin_kael.prompt: The same hero as in 图片1 (keep the identical face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color and costume), redrawn as a brand-new close-up action illustration: Kael Valcrane, young human vampire hunter, long dark brown ponytail, crimson bandana headband, amber-brown eyes, dark brown leather hunter coat with high collar and silver trim, silver cross pendant, cracking a glowing golden holy whip that arcs across the frame, holy sparks, fierce determined shout. Human: no fangs, no glowing eyes. Extreme dynamic close-up for a fighting-game super-move cut-in, 21:9 ultra-wide cinematic framing, the character's face and upper body fill the right half of the frame, head turned three-quarters toward the viewer, intense eyes at about 40% from the top of the image, weapon crossing the frame diagonally, strong motion, wind-blown hair and cloth, dramatic rim light in golden holy light, dark background with crimson smoke and ember particles, the left 45% of the image is darker negative space, painterly anime-influenced dark gothic fantasy illustration, high detail, sharp focus on the eyes, single character only, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no border, no frame.
